name: Ayu Glass
notes: A Zed theme, not a VS Code one: there's no VS Code Ayu Glass. lib/zed.mjs translates it.
The glass is window translucency (background.appearance: blurred). The editor/terminal backgrounds are used at full opacity, so the terminal tools get the tint without the see-through.

Zed's Ayu has no magenta (terminal.ansi.magenta is a second cyan) and no orange distinct from yellow. magenta uses Ayu's purple (constants) and orange its keyword orange, as Ayu's VS Code terminal does.

Zed's bright ANSI colors here are dimmed toward the background (bright red #83353b on dark, bright black is blue on light), unreadable as terminal brights. They're set to the normal hues, and bright black to fgSecondary so zsh autosuggestions stay legible.
